Standard: The brakes maintain running clearances throughout the wear life of the brake heat stack including thermal effects to allow the air vehicle to meet stopping distances, avoid collisions, and provide the flight crew with consistent brake application characteristics to maintain air vehicle control. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Test.
(1) Lab test: Conduct lab testing to verify the brakes maintain running clearances when brake command is removed and as the brake stack wears.
